question: The ________ city has been named as the host of the International Olympic Committee session in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mumbai** has been named as the host of the International Olympic Committee session in 2023.
 
• This marks a significant event as it is the first time in four decades that India will host such a session.
 
• The last time India hosted an IOC session was in 1983 in New Delhi.
 
• The decision was made during the 139th IOC Session held in Beijing, China.
 
• Mumbai was selected unanimously, reflecting the city's robust infrastructure and capacity to host international events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is a non-governmental sports organization based in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• Founded by Pierre de Coubertin and Demetrios Vikelas in 1894, the IOC is the authority responsible for organizing the modern Olympic Games.
 
• IOC sessions are significant as they involve discussions and decisions regarding the Olympic movement, including the selection of host cities for future games.
 
• Hosting an IOC session is a prestigious event and provides the host city with an opportunity to showcase its culture and infrastructure to a global audience.
 
• India's selection as a host reflects its growing importance and influence in the global sports arena.
